QUOTE: "Only one of the three is cleared by a rebuild." and "Code axis: restart the client. Rebuilding is unsafe here, not just ineffective."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says data staleness is cleared by a refresh or rebuild and code staleness by a client restart. It frames the axes as separate because each needs a different fix. It never says outright that one flag would not have been enough, but that follows from the framing.
